6ed54b22180392d7.description: About the opportunity We are looking for a Rider Hiring Supervisor to lead our courier recruitment and activation operations, oversee team performance and operational targets, and drive continuous improvements across our courier acquisition processes. This role will be responsible not only for managing day-to-day operations but also for performance analysis, team coordination, process improvement, and close collaboration with central teams. Key Responsibilities Manage the day-to-day operations of the Courier Contact Center and ensure business continuity. Oversee the end-to-end courier recruitment, application follow-up, and activation processes. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including recruitment performance, application-to-activation conversion rates, and activation targets, and develop action plans to achieve business objectives.
